title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns as analysts cut price targets and debate where the AI trade goes next
summary: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang resigned, and Yorkville Ives cut its price target on the chipmaker to $225 from $300 while keeping a buy rating, according to CNBC&\#x27;s "ETF Edge." Investing experts interviewed on the program said other Big Tech companies and chipmakers such as AMD and Broadcom could absorb AI demand if investors lose confidence in Nvidia, with Roundhill&\#x27;s Dave Mazza arguing "net-net Big Tech ends up as the winner once again."
